messages.subject: how to add arrow annotation
parts:
Hello:

I am wondering how to add arrow annotation on a graph in ggplot2. I
have used matlab to do this, the command is like:

annotation(figure (3),'arrow',[0.3 0.3],...
[0.1 0.17],'HeadWidth',6,'LineWidth',1)

You need to provide the arrow location and the line type etc.

Any pointer?

Thanks.

Xiaoyu

messages.subject: Re: how to add arrow annotation
parts:
I think the idea is similar, but it will take two lines to do it. 

First the arrow: 

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_segment.html

geom_segment takes the starting coordinates and the end of the arrow coordinates. 

Then the text would be done with geom_text
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/geom_text.html

you'll have to supply the coordinates of the text from the arrow and adjust it slightly depending on which side of the arrow you want it to appear. You'll likely have to use hjust to adjust the horizontal justification so that the text doesn't overlap the arrow or other points. 


Brandon
